source: Proposed by openai/gpt-oss-120b from the crawled pages (see data/vocabulary_proposed.json for the evidence), then reviewed and corrected by the author.
review_changes: Flattened 3 two-level chains caught by the checks: deep learning, human rights law and graph analytics.
Replaced 'big data' and 'graph analytics' with 'data engineering' (DEAI's core: databases, data warehouses, big data and graph processing).
Added 'mathematics and statistics' (stochastic methods, statistical learning, linear algebra courses).
Moved computer vision and natural language processing under artificial intelligence; made technology governance top-level.
Corrected every ISCED-F code: the model had given occupation-style or arts codes (e.g. 0213 is Fine arts, not computer science).
Removed the degree field 'robotics': it came from a motivation-letter sentence, not an admission rule.
Removed prerequisite knowledge (programming, operating systems, linear algebra) from degree-field synonyms.
Merged european studies and international relations into political science.
Added 'mechanical engineering' (0715) so a mechanical engineering degree can be recorded; no programme names it as accepted.
